Brazil's World Cup stadium in Natal is up for sale because the company that owns it is having money problems after a corruption scandal. The owner, Grupo OAS, is selling Natal's Dunas Arena. The simple hatchback is 50 years old this year. It may not be as fast as a Ferrari or as regal as a Rolls Royce, but it is the most popular car in the world. Originally designed to help French farmers transport their sheep to market, this car now accounts for a staggering two in every three cars sold in the UK. It is just as popular across the world, from Munich to Mexico City, thanks to its practical design, economy and comfort.

The model credited with being the world’s first ever hatchback was the Renault 16, unveiled in April 1965. The Renault 4 was the forerunner to the Renault 16 and was first designed to allow French farmers to transport sheep.

Almeria have appointed Sergi Barjuan as their third coach this season. The 43-year-old replaces Juan Ignacio Martinez, who was fired after a 4-1 home defeat to Levante.
